name: RenAi Blogger
source: Play as a young man named Chase who recently moved to New York to study Japanese language and culture. A short dating-sim/visual novel involving certain popular figures in the anime blogosphere and the task of getting a date to an anime con.
translation: 玩家将扮演名叫蔡斯的年轻男子。他最近搬到纽约，学习日本语言与文化。这是一部简短的恋爱模拟视觉小说，部分角色取材自动画博客圈的知名人物；玩家的任务是找到一名愿意陪自己参加动漫展的约会对象。
